messages:
maria: Heads up — saw quick-insights hovercard show metrics from the previously selected org after I switched orgs. Repro 3/3 on staging. Anyone else?

jon: Oof. steps?

maria: 1) switch org from A -> B in console 2) open insights hovercard on dashboard 3) hover -> shows A's data briefly then flips to B. Noticed a 'flash' where A metric visible for ~200ms.

keerthi: is this the prefetch cache again or a client-side state issue?

sam: @keerthi I think it's the new micro-frontend lazy-mount change that defers fetching until mount — we rely on header `x-workspace-id` being preserved in the internal API call, but the embeddable iframe drops it.

maria: I captured network and logs. Trace: trace-04c9. Header missing on /internal/metrics/quick-insights/request with cookie present. Attached snippet: 
```http
GET /internal/metrics/quick-insights?card=hover
Host: console.internal
Cookie: session=...
# NO x-workspace-id header
```

console-bot: deploy: canary rollout of mf-lazy-mount v2 -> prod started at 08:21 UTC

jon: If header is missing, backend routes to cached-affinity or defaults to last-known org in session store. That would cause the flash.

keerthi: So two paths: fix MFE to forward header OR change internal route to always resolve workspace from token + query param and ignore client header fallback. Which do we prefer?

sam: Changing backend is safer but risky for canary. Could do temporary patch: when header missing, treat request as 'no-cache' (bypass prefix cache) so no stale info. Minimal change.

maria: Agree. Also telemetry is noisy — our metrics dashboards show a spike in 'hovercard-flash' events starting 09:10. I can attach the eval. We should add regression alert.

jon: Plan: (1) hotfix backend to treat missing x-workspace-id as no-cache + add feature flag `no_header_bypass` (2) rollback canary for mf-lazy-mount until fix deployed (3) add unit test for header propagation and integration test for quick-insights hover sequence (4) add telemetry alert + sample query to reproduce

keerthi: I'll open PR for backend hotfix, add flag. Sam — can you coordinate canary rollback?

sam: On it. Rolling back mf-lazy-mount v2 in staging and pausing prod canary. ETA 10m.

maria: Dropping logs: 
```
[2026-01-12T09:14:22Z] trace=trace-04c9 svc=console-internal msg="incoming request" path=/internal/metrics/quick-insights headers={cookie:..., user-agent:..., x-request-id:abc}
[2026-01-12T09:14:22Z] trace=trace-04c9 svc=console-internal msg="resolved workspace" workspace_id=org-A from=cache
```
Note 'from=cache' — that's our leak.

jon: :thumbsup: Keerthi, please add a quick telemetry query so support can look up incidents. Something like: 
```
select count(*) from hover_events where event='hovercard_flash' and env='prod' group by minute
```

keerthi: Will add. Also suggests we add a console-level guard: when switching orgs, invalidate in-memory quick-insight cache for the previous org.

maria: Added a repro gif in thread. Also found one edge: users with 'view_as' toggles are more likely to see it.

sam: Canary rolled back. prod traffic to v2 paused. I also pushed the temporary bypass patch to staging: https://git.redwood/p/console-internal/pull/842

console-bot: pr-merge: #842 merged into staging by keerthi

jon: Nice. Next steps: code review for permanent fix (no reliance on client header). Add e2e that switches orgs + hovers and assert no data from previous org visible. Assign owners: Keerthi (backend), Maria (repro + telemetry), Sam (release).

maria: Thanks all. I'll open the alert and tag support. @support FYI — this caused a small user-facing flash UI; we rolled back canary.

support: ack — will watch for customer pings and escalate if needed.
